{{Horus}}
Horus 5 is the 369th day of the year in the [[Gaian calendar]]. It is an intercalary day, the 5th of the 7 days of Horus. It falls on a Friday in intercalary week 53.

Its informal Japanese name is 14宮5日.

On this day, [[Gaiad chapter 369|Chapter 369]] of the [[Gaiad]] is read.

To see structured data on this date see {{q|Q152388}}.
